section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces two studies. The first study is cross-sectional, examining the direct and indirect associations between appearance goals, regulation of exercise behavior, and body image using a structural equation framework. The second study employs a 2x2 experimental design to manipulate appearance goals for exercise and guilt related to not exercising, aiming to provide a more robust test of the proposed mediation process. Both studies utilized a sample of young adult women.
